thread:
irina: quick debrief — ran Emerald14B -> INT3 smoke tests on a small prod-like slice (chat + rerank). results below. TL;DR: ~3.4x token cost reduction vs FP16, but quality regressions on multi-step prompts and rerank top-1 precision drop (~4pp). latency median OK, tail +10-20ms.

irina: raw numbers (small slice, ~25k requests):
```
FP16 mean cost/token: $0.00014
INT3 mean cost/token: $0.000041
cost reduction: 3.4x
rerank top1 precision FP16: 0.872
rerank top1 precision INT3: 0.832
hallucination rate (long-form) FP16: 2.1%
INT3: 9.5%
```

tyler: thanks. do we have breakdown by prompt class (instruction vs few-shot vs code)?
irina: yes — INT3 holds up for casual chat and short Q/A. breaks on multi-step reasoning and code generation (precision and consistency drop). rerank suffers on near-tie cases — confidence scores collapse.

maria: quick unit-econ thought: if token cost drops 3.4x, p50 cost per 1M tokens goes from ~$140 to ~$41. but if we lose 4pp of rerank precision on paid features, revenue risk may offset savings. need product input.
jordan: can we limit INT3 to non-revenue-critical routes? e.g., system messages, casual completion, low-importance assistants. keep rerank, codegen on INT6/FP16.
sara: +1. also want a lightweight eval: 500 annotated rerank pairs to quantify user-visible impact. if delta >3pp, hold.

irina: proposed rollout plan:
- Canary 5% traffic to emerald14b-int3 for chat-only intents (non-rerank).
- Run 1k human annotations for rerank-sensitive intents before expanding.
- Add routing flag so GTN can opt-in per route.
- If rerank precision drop >2.5pp, auto-fallback to INT6 for those routes.

ops-bot: deploy started -> canary pool: emerald14b-int3 (5%) at 2026-03-20T15:08:30Z :rocket:
tyler: nit — we should instrument confidence distribution and top2 gap metric; that will give early warning for near-tie collapse. set alert if mean top2 gap < 0.06 for any route.
maria: also snippet for quick econ calc if folks want to reproduce:
```
cost_fp16_per_m = 140
cost_int3_per_m = cost_fp16_per_m / 3.4
savings_per_m = cost_fp16_per_m - cost_int3_per_m
```

jordan: recommendation summary for GTN/product: use INT3 for low-risk chat and experimental user tiers; require INT6 for rerank, codegen, and safety-critical flows. enable routing flags + human-in-the-loop eval for initial 10k real requests.
sara: I'll own the 500 annotated rerank pairs. timeline: 3 business days.
irina: thanks — I'll instrument top2 gap and confidence histograms, and add canary dashboards. posting sample eval set to the drive now.

irina: action items: 1) canary (ops) 2) top2-gap alert (eng-ml) 3) 500 rerank pairs (sara) 4) product decision after annotations (maria).

tyler: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: canary health check passed (latency/p50 within SLO, tail +12ms).
